purpose: Reduce the owner's review of round 3 by a second, independent extraction: the owner reviews every entry where the two extractions disagree, every entry the method cannot compare, and a fixed random sample of the agreements. Track B of the Fable plan.

in_scope.why: Their source PDFs are in supplemental-information (the five labels, the REVLIMID label of 3/2023, the four articles behind the assays and Hughes 2019).

out_of_scope.handling: Reviewed in full by the owner; their PDFs are not on file yet.

second_reader.given: the blinded entries (intelligence_store/double_extraction.blind_items): an opaque id, the source document and location, the measure with every number masked, and the field names to fill; and the source PDFs
second_reader.not_given: the platform extract files, the round 3 queue, the first extraction's values, earlier review records or reviews
second_reader.rules: Reads the PDF itself; fills every field from the source at the stated location; copies each quote exactly; may not run code that searches the source for values; writes one JSON line per entry {blind_id, value}.

comparison.agreement: Every number in the entry (numeric fields and numbers written in text fields; quotes, ids and locations excluded) matches between the two extractions as a multiset, after removing thousands separators.
comparison.quotes: Each second-reader quote must be found in the source by scripts/check_source_quotes.py; a quote not found makes the entry a disagreement.
comparison.not_comparable: Entries with no numbers (33 of the 100) cannot be compared this way and are reviewed in full.
comparison.missing: An entry the second reader does not answer, or answers twice, is a disagreement.

owner_review.disagreements: every one, against the source, recording which extraction (if either) is right

agreements.method: double_extraction.agreement_sample over the sorted ids of agreeing entries

decision_rule.pass: If none of the 20 sampled agreements is wrong, the remaining agreements are recorded as "agreed by two independent extractions, sampled", not as owner-reviewed.
decision_rule.fail: If any sampled agreement is wrong (both extractions made the same error), every remaining agreement is reviewed in full.
decision_rule.labels: Pages keep saying which values the owner reviewed; agreed-and-sampled values are labelled as such.

limits: Two AI extractions that agree can share an error; the sample bounds how often, roughly: 0 errors in 20 gives a 95% upper bound of about 14% on the error rate among agreements (one-sided exact binomial). The second reader is the same model family as the first.
never: The blinded entries, agreement rule, sample size and seed are not changed after the second reader has started; the platform extract files are not edited because of this review (a wrong value gets a new versioned file, as always).
